{{Quote|A clone never leaves anything half-done, sir!|Stripe, to Rex|<ref name="MouseHunt" />}}
'''Stripe''' was the name of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were recognized among their brothers by a white-colored stripe on their black hair. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Stripe was stationed at a [[Pastil tracking station/Legends|Republic tracking station]] in the [[Pastil system/Legends|Pastil system]] that was assigned to warn the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] of any impending [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] attacks. During an inspection of the base by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], an [[MSE-series]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] nicknamed "[[Rodent (droid)|Rodent]]" that helped the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] maintain the station was revealed to be an undercover [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. Stripe [[Skirmish on Pastil|helped]] the officers find the droid, and when the droid turned out to be merely a shell for the droid's wheels, which were individual droids on their own, they helped to hunt down and destroy all of them, successfully eliminating the spy threat to the station.

==Biography==
===Early life===
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who took on the name of Stripe<ref name="MouseHunt" /> was born on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Like all of their brothers, Stripe was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the famous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], born and trained to fight for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> However, the escalating [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] relentlessly demanded more [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to fight in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Army/Legends|army]], and many younger clones&mdash;including Stripe&mdash;were rushed into service before completing their intensive training.<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref> Stripe was assigned to a remote [[Pastil tracking station/Legends|tracking station]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet of [[Pastil/Legends|Pastil]], that was supposed to warn the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] in case of an attack by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="MouseHunt" /><ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}}</ref>

===Service at the Pastil station===
{{Quote|Rodent's a ''glitching'' MSE droid. He spends ''hours'' polishing that station.|Stripe|<ref name="MouseHunt" />}}
[[File:Stripe.png|thumb|left|Stripe, witnessing the spy droid escaping]]
In addition to a contingent of at least five clone troopers, the Pastil tracking station was also maintained by an [[MSE-series]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] nicknamed "[[Rodent (droid)|Rodent]]" by the clones.<ref name="MouseHunt" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Mouse Hunt date">{{TCWdates|105}} ''[[The Clone Wars: Mouse Hunt]]'' is set immediately prior to "Rookies," placing it in 22 BBY as well.</ref> the Pastil station was inspected by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]. While Cody reminded the "rookies" of the importance of their seemingly boring duty, Rex noted that the station looked unusually clean. Stripe explained to his superior officers that Rodent spent a significant amount of time polishing the station, and that the clones believed the droid to have a glitch in its programming. The inspecting officers, however, immediately noticed the droid's action as traits of a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and issued a [[Code Aurek]] alert on the station. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex [[Skirmish on Pastil|ordered]] the clone troopers to comb the station and find the droid by whatever means necessary. During the search, fellow clone trooper "[[Bouncer (clone trooper)|Bouncer]]" wondered whether the officers did this at every inspection, but Stripe replied and told Bouncer not to ask stupid questions.<ref name="MouseHunt" />

When the droid was finally spotted, Rex shot at it with<ref name="MouseHunt" /> his<ref name="RexEncyclopedia">{{SWE|characters|rex|Clone Captain Rex}}</ref> [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|blaster]]. After the droid's body was destroyed, its four "wheels" activated and ran off in different directions, much to the surprise of the rookie troopers. Two of the four wheels were destroyed by the clone troopers, and Stripe disabled the third one by directing electrical energy from a loose wire at it. Stripe then noticed that the fourth wheel droid was heading toward a grate and realized that if it escaped, it would be impossible to find. Determined to stop the spy, Stripe threw a [[V-1 thermal detonator]] at the grate, destroying both the droid and a solid portion of the station's interior. When Captain Rex asked Stripe if such a radical solution was necessary, Stripe proudly responded that the clones did not leave anything half-done. Rex then told the troopers to clean up the mess caused by the [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator's]] explosion before departing along with Cody. With the spy neutralized,<ref name="MouseHunt" /> Cody later reported to [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] that the Pastil station was fully operational.<ref name="Rookies" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Over there! By the grate! If it gets through, we'll ''never'' find it!|Stripe|<ref name="MouseHunt" />}}
[[File:StripeAndRex.png|thumb|right|250px|Stripe and Rex, after neutralizing the spy]]
Stripe had a white [[Hair dye|dyed]] stripe in their black hair. The trooper was loyal to the Republic, and although they initially didn't realize Rodent was a spy, they took Rex's Code Aurek alert seriously, telling Bouncer not to ask stupid questions when the latter mused that the alert was a simple drill. Stripe later improvised a plan to disable a wheel droid with electrical energy from a loose wire. When seeing that another wheel droid was about to escape, Stripe decided to stop it by using a thermal detonator, even if it meant damaging the station's interior. When asked by a superior officer if they considered their actions to be overkill, Stripe proudly responded that as a clone they never left anything half-done.<ref name="MouseHunt" />

==Equipment==
Stripe wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with a black stripe going down their chest plate.<ref name="MouseHunt" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stripe appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Mouse Hunt|''Mouse Hunt'']], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' web comic series]]. The webcomic was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], illustrated by [[Tom Hodges]],<ref name="MouseHunt" /> and published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[October 23]], [[2008]].<ref name="Archives">{{SWArchive|url=archives/index.html?c=d6de5d83-4da5-48ab-bf34-75cd3af8fbef&k=&page=9|text=''The Clone Wars'' archives}}</ref>
